Train 690 that was scheduled to travel between Churchill and The Pas on August 4th, has been cancelled from Thompson to The Pas with no alternate transportation due to infrastructure issues.    Passengers detraining in Thompson or before will not be affected by this partial cancellation.   Recent severe weather conditions have caused multiple washouts and infrastructure damage on portions of the railway network between Winnipeg and Canora. The resulting operational impacts have affected our ability to maintain all scheduled service on the Winnipeg–Churchill route.

Train 693 that was scheduled to travel between Winnipeg and Churchill on August 4th, has been cancelled from Winnipeg to Thompson with no alternate transportation due to infrastructure issues.   The train will only be in service from Thompson to Churchill.   Recent severe weather conditions have caused multiple washouts and infrastructure damage on portions of the railway network between Winnipeg and Canora. The resulting operational impacts have affected our ability to maintain all scheduled service on the Winnipeg–Churchill route.
